Support for models fitted by gamm4

Source: R/gamm4-methods.R
gamm4_support.Rd

Models fitted by gamm4::gamm4() (version 0.2-7 or later) have class "gamm4". Pass the fitted object directly to gratia methods; historical unclassed lists are not supported.

Details

Smooths, parametric effects, predictions, derivatives, simulations, and posterior draws describe the population GAM component. Terms supplied through random are excluded, including their realized effects, predictive variation, and uncertainty. conditional_values() and conditional_differences() condition on covariate values, not on realized group effects. Group variables occurring only in random are not required in prediction data, so new groups receive the same population predictions. Use the mer component with lme4 for predictions conditional on group effects and simulations including their variation. Diagnostics use the fitted GAM component, whose working residuals reflect the conditional mixed-model fit; they are not a substitute for mixed-model diagnostics.

Gaussian draws use the fitted GAM coefficient covariance matrix, including its uncertainty due to fitting the mixed model. User draws must have one column per GAM coefficient. Metropolis-Hastings sampling is unsupported: the GAM likelihood does not include the additional random effects. Smoothness uncertainty-corrected covariance matrices and alternative EDF are unavailable from gamm4; requested corrections warn and fall back to the available covariance matrix or EDF. Variance components are extracted from the mixed-model component, with smooth labels and random-effect term names (separate penalties on a tensor smooth retain their grouping suffix); interval bounds are NA because they are not supplied by the fit.
